purpose: Validate the shape and multi-seed stability of the occupancy-matched within-band lineage instrument; do not tune real-model thresholds.
reference_rule: theta=0 low-band consensus separately for each seed

construction_invariants.complete_occupancy_spectrum: maximum absolute difference from the seed reference <= 1e-10

shape_diagnostics.mean_chordal_lineage: expected to track cos^2(theta) up to context-geometry and solver residuals
shape_diagnostics.monotonicity: nonincreasing within seed, reported as a construction check
shape_diagnostics.cos2_residual: descriptive; no tolerance is promoted from the external one-seed sweep
shape_diagnostics.policy_and_edit_flip_locations: descriptive fixture constants, explicitly prohibited as thresholds
shape_diagnostics.tail_noise: report standardized uplift at 80, 85, and 90 degrees without redefining the policy gate

claim_boundary: A successful calibration establishes synthetic dose-response shape and construction invariants only. It cannot establish real-model lineage utility or any self-improvement threshold.
